guideBlocks.title: Choose the documented archive member
guideBlocks.text: This archive has an aspirin_pc/maps script tree and a separate member named exactly patch_mp.ff PS3. The readme describes the trickshot menu and credits but supplies no PS3 loader, game update, region or copy destination. Do not copy the PC script tree as though it were the console build, and do not guess a rename or destination for the PS3-labelled member.

guideBlocks.title: Select the PS3 folder
guideBlocks.text: The archive has separate Project Concord/PS3 and Project Concord/Xbox folders. The PS3 folder contains patch_mp.ff; the Xbox folder also includes default_mp.xex. Use only the PS3-labelled variant for PS3 research. No installation readme or exact game update was supplied.

guideBlocks.title: Select the PS3 variant
guideBlocks.text: The Jxsh Private Patch archive contains distinct PS3 and Xbox folders. The PS3-labelled file is PS3/patch_mp.ff. The Xbox default_mp.xex belongs to the separate Xbox distribution. No readme establishes an installation path, title ID or game update for the PS3 file.

guideBlocks.title: Separate console variants
guideBlocks.text: The archive contains Project GoodBye/PS3/patch_mp.ff and a different Xbox folder with patch_mp.ff and default_mp.xex. Keep the variants separate. The captured archive includes no PS3 installation readme, so confirm the game update, title ID and destination before replacing an original file.

guideBlocks.title: Choose the correct console folder
guideBlocks.text: Dundee Patch contains separate PS3/patch_mp.ff and Xbox/patch_mp.ff variants; only the Xbox folder includes default_mp.xex. Do not mix those distributions. The archive provides no installation readme or exact PS3 compatibility requirement.

guideBlocks.title: Button labels in the readme
guideBlocks.text: The original instructions use Xbox-style button names: go prone and press X to toggle the menu; shoot to scroll down; aim to scroll up; X selects; melee returns to the main menu. Confirm the corresponding controls for a documented PS3 port rather than assuming those labels map directly to a PS3 controller.

guideBlocks.title: Read the supplied control-layout instructions
guideBlocks.text: The archive includes common.ff, code_post_gfx.ff, a button-instructions text file and an advanced RTF guide. On the default layout, the text says to go prone and press X to open the menu. Its tactical instructions use D-pad Up for MainCFG and D-pad Down for Binds before other shortcuts. The documentation uses Xbox-style A, B, X, Y, RB and LB labels; it does not document a PS3 button mapping or file destination.

guideBlocks.title: Keep layout-specific binds together
guideBlocks.text: The advanced guide separates Default, Tactical and Lefty layouts and several CFG submenus. Their shortcuts differ. Use the included layout-specific documentation for the selected build and confirm PS3 requirements before copying files or applying those button labels.

guideBlocks.title: Included guide: private matches on other maps

items.title: Select a map through the online menu
items.text: From the main menu, open Nazi Zombies, then Play Online, Find Game and Nazi Zombies. Select the desired map.

items.title: Return to private match
items.text: Back out, then choose Private Match. The included note describes this preparation for maps other than Nacht der Untoten.

guideBlocks.title: Installation requirements are separate
guideBlocks.text: The archive contains patch.ff and the map-selection note. It does not provide an installation destination, firmware requirement, title ID or exact game update.

members: How to host on other maps!.txt

guideBlocks.title: Readme installation path needs confirmation
guideBlocks.text: The readme places patch.ff under dev_hdd0/game/(COD W@W Game ID)/USDIR/English. It spells the directory USDIR rather than USRDIR, so verify the actual directory on the matching game before copying anything. Preserve the original file; the readme does not specify a title ID or update.

guideBlocks.title: Readme controls
items: Aim with L1 and use melee to open the menu.
R1 scrolls down, L1 scrolls up and Square selects.
Melee (R3) returns or closes the menu.
D-pad Up enables the menu's rank and prestige options without an on-screen confirmation, according to the readme.

guideBlocks.title: Der Riese private-match note
guideBlocks.text: The readme says Der Riese may appear with a checkerboard preview. It describes selecting Der Riese through online search, backing out and then opening Private Match. This is a distributor note, not a hardware test result.

guideBlocks.title: What this archive documents

guideBlocks.title: Beta status in the readme
